notes: The photo-feed picker now works: choose the Met Museum, Art Institute of Chicago, Wikimedia landscapes, or NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day and that is what you get. Adds Synology Photos shared albums as a screensaver source. Home Assistant gains media volume and mute controls over MQTT. Shared-album loading is more resilient: a mid-fetch failure now shows the photos already loaded instead of falling back to the built-in feed.
